name: accnotify-desktop
description: Accnotify Windows 和 macOS 客户端

scripts.check: npm run sync-version && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.package:mac: npm run sync-version && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.package:win: npm run sync-version && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.prepare: npm run sync-version && npm run sync-assets
